XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Engine stalling whilst driving, followed by difficulty restarting, engine fault warning light on
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INIEZIONE | P0191 | P1761 | REGOLATORE | PRESSIONE | CARBURANTE | DIESEL | GASOLIO | RENDE | PERDE | CALA | MANCA | POTENZA | VELOCITà | CALO | ACCENDE | ACCESA | MIL | ROSSO | ROSSA | MINIMO | FUNZIONA | BENE |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Reliability level key

* low level : Reported by a garage mechanic; fault case not recorded by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Widespread occurrence of the fault, confirmed by service technicians and independent repairers.

*** high level : Confirmed fault, with a high degree of ‘recurrence’ reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Fuel pressure regulator

  • Fault: Sudden engine stalling whilst driving, followed by difficulty restarting and the red engine fault light coming on. When the engine is idling, the vehicle runs smoothly.

  • Fault codes detected by the on-board diagnostics:
    • P0191 (Fuel line pressure sensor – Incorrect setpoint)
    • P1761 (Fuel pressure control – Fault)
  • Cause: Faulty fuel pressure regulator

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the fuel pressure regulator and, if necessary, replace it

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The component is located centrally, between the engine and the radiator, on the high-pressure fuel pump. It is not necessary to remove the high-pressure fuel pump in order to remove the regulator.

    The estimated time for the service is approximately 0.4 h.
